posts.title: How Will We Judge?
posts.description: I hate that we have to judge theorists but departments need to make decisions about PhD admission, faculty hiring, tenure and promotion. posts.title: Fall Jobs Post 2026
posts.description: Each fall I try to predict the upcoming job market for theoretical computer science faculty and give suggestions to those pursuing these positions. Last year I wrote that we should get set for a rocky ride, with AI’s disruption of computer science, fiscal stress at universities, and new U.S. policies affecting visas and funding. Rocky indeed.
